full_list.title_en: Classical-to-DFT multi-fidelity approach for developing machine learning potentials of aqueous systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Classical-to-DFT multi-fidelity approach for developing machine learning potentials of aqueous systems
full_list.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer near– ab initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost of conventional electronic structure calculations, but their reliability depends critically on the quality and diversity of training data. Here, we present a classical-to-density functional theory (DFT) multi-fidelity workflow for efficient dataset generation, in which long classical molecular dynamics trajectories are supplemented with selectively DFT-optimized configurations to train neural network potentials. We demonstrate this approach on four systems: bulk water, water at the air–water interface, CaSO 4 in bulk water, and CaSO 4 at the interface. In all cases, the trained models faithfully reproduce reference DFT properties, validating the workflow across both simple and chemically complex environments. We further probe the extrapolation capabilities of the models, showing that bulk-trained networks can generalize to different temperatures, pressures, and interfacial geometries when datasets include targeted augmented configurations. This multi-fidelity strategy thus enables accurate and transferable MLIPs for complex solvated and interfacial systems, bridging the gap between computational efficiency and first-principles accuracy.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：机器学习势与原子级动力学, 神经网络原子间势, 分子动力学与有限温度轨迹，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: A hierarchical adaptive Fourier-feature physics-informed neural network for radio-frequency capacitively coupled plasma discharges
full_list.title_zh: 用于射频电容耦合等离子体放电的分层自适应傅里叶特征物理通知神经网络
full_list.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are difficult to train for radio-frequency capacitively coupled plasma fluid-Poisson systems because missing initial conditions, steep sheath gradients, and strongly imbalanced residuals can lead to unstable or nonunique reconstructions. We propose a Hierarchical Adaptive Fourier-feature PINN (HA-FPINN) for such coupled plasma models. The method combines Fourier feature mapping to improve the representation of small-scale sheath structures, sparse physical anchors to provide interior constraints, and a two-level adaptive weighting scheme to balance the PDE, boundary, and anchor losses as well as individual equation residuals. The framework is tested on an 8-equation helium discharge model and a 23-equation electronegative model. In the helium case, HA-FPINN reconstructs the space-time evolution of the main physical variables with anchors and converges for all tested network architectures, with convergence times of – s. In the case, HA-FPINN achieves stable reconstruction with anchors, whereas the non-adaptive FPINN and standard PINN fail to converge under the same setting. The best performance in both systems is obtained at the tested Fourier frequency parameter . Noise-injection tests show that HA-FPINN maintains the lowest reconstruction error in the helium case and preserves the main space-time structures in the case at anchor noise levels of up to . These results show that HA-FPINN provides a robust PINN formulation for strongly coupled plasma fluid models with missing initial conditions.

full_list.title_en: Validating Graph Neural Network Feature Attribution Through Local Perturbations: A Study on CoMoFeNiCu Decomposition Enthalpy
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Validating Graph Neural Network Feature Attribution Through Local Perturbations: A Study on CoMoFeNiCu Decomposition Enthalpy
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) show promise for predicting materials properties, but interpretability remains a challenge, particularly understanding whether attributed feature importance reflects physical reality or statistical artifacts. Here, we present a methods validation study that deliberately overfits a physics-aware GNN ensemble to probe the robustness of feature-ranking approaches. Using the CoMoFeNiCu high-entropy alloy system with three stoichiometries, we train GNNs to predict decomposition enthalpies from DFT-calculated structures while explicitly constraining output weights to encode feature importance. By design, our dataset is limited (approximately 900 binary and 4,500 ternary decomposition pathways) to control compositional complexity and enable precise interrogation of local chemistry effects. We validate that feature rankings capture meaningful local-environment information through a series of atomic swap perturbations: perturbing individual atomic sites and re-ranking features reveals spatial decay consistent with the GNN's interaction cutoff, confirming that weights encode neighbor-shell effects rather than global stoichiometric artifacts alone. Results demonstrate that feature attribution methods can remain physically interpretable even under overfitting, provided validation is rigorous. This work establishes a foundation for trustworthy interpretability in materials GNNs and sets the stage for scaling to multiple chemistries and testing generalization across compositional spaces.

full_list.title_en: Machine learning of strength surfaces enables high regularization length phase-field fracture
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine learning of strength surfaces enables high regularization length phase-field fracture
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18473v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Classical phase-field models of brittle fracture capture toughness-controlled crack growth but not the material's strength surface, which governs crack nucleation. The theory of Kumar et al. (2020) incorporates the strength surface through a nucleation driving force, and Chockalingam (2025) derived this driving force for arbitrary strength surfaces described by n material parameters, with which the phase-field strength surface (PFSS) converges to the material strength surface as the regularization length ε → 0 and matches it exactly at n chosen states for any ε. In practice, however, the strength surface must be supplied as an analytic form chosen and calibrated case by case, and for the widely used analytic surfaces (n=2) accurate strength reproduction requires ε commensurate with the Irwin characteristic length lcₕ, imposing prohibitive mesh requirements for large structures. We introduce a neural-network (NN) strength function that is learned directly from strength data, is physics-constrained by construction, and provides far more calibration parameters than analytic surfaces; the calibration is generalized to any number of strength states and to enforce openness in chosen directions. A single architecture captures synthetic data from the Mohr-Coulomb, Drucker-Prager, Mogi-Coulomb and 3D Hoek-Brown surfaces and experimental data for graphite, natural rubber and styrene-butadiene rubber. The resulting PFSS is accurate up to ε = 10,lcₕ, whereas that of the exact analytic surfaces performs comparatively poorly even at ε = 0.5,lcₕ. Finite-element simulations validate the theory across fracture regimes. By decoupling strength fidelity from the regularization length, the approach substantially reduces the mesh resolution required for phase-field fracture simulations of large structures.

full_list.title_en: From spectra to performance: Multimodal machine learning for organic optoelectronic materials discovery
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：From spectra to performance: Multimodal machine learning for organic optoelectronic materials discovery
full_list.abstract: The discovery and rational optimization of optoelectronic materials increasingly rely on heterogeneous characterization data encoding structure, morphology, electronic states, and device properties. Conventional spectral interpretation remains expert-dependent and often treats each modality in isolation, limiting information extraction. Machine learning has improved information extraction from individual spectroscopic modalities, yet single modality approaches often suffer from incomplete structural and physical representations. Multimodal machine learning enables integration of diverse spectroscopic signals into unified representations. In this review, we summarize recent advances in multimodal spectral learning and heterogeneous data fusion for spectra–structure–property relationships in optoelectronic materials. We discuss how the synergistic combination of infrared, Raman, nuclear magnetic resonance, and mass spectrometry improves functional-group recognition, substructure inference, and spectrum-based molecular structure elucidation and raw-spectrum learning for molecular elucidation. We further elaborate on how the fusion of optical spectra, morphology, processing parameters, and molecular representations facilitates quantitative property prediction and materials discovery. Key challenges include simulation-experiment domain gaps, limited multimodal datasets, missing modalities, and insufficient model interpretability. Overall, multimodal spectral learning is emerging as a promising approach for transforming characterization from a descriptive tool into a predictive framework for rational materials design.

full_list.title_en: Enhanced Hyperspectral Nano-FTIR Imaging by Neural-Network-Based Processing of Multiple Signal Harmonics
full_list.title_zh: 通过基于神经网络的多信号谐波处理增强超光谱纳米FTIR成像
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nano-FTIR spectroscopy combines infrared spectroscopy with nanometer-scale spatial resolution and enables hyperspectral nanoimaging. However, quantitative measurements typically rely on higher-harmonic near-field signals, which are largely background-free but suffer from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Lower harmonics provide substantially higher SNR but contain significant background contributions that distort the near-field response and hinder quantitative analysis. Here, we introduce a cross-harmonic neural network (CHNN) that exploits the complementary information encoded in multiple harmonic channels to denoise third-harmonic hyperspectral data. Trained directly on experimental nano-FTIR datasets, the CHNN uses first- and second-harmonic spectra to improve the SNR of the third-harmonic response. Applied to a PMMA/PS polymer blend, it substantially reduces noise while preserving spectral features and nanoscale spatial contrast. Compared with conventional single-harmonic denoising using an autoencoder, the CHNN achieves superior noise suppression. These results demonstrate the potential of lower-harmonic signals for improving hyperspectral nano-FTIR imaging without increasing acquisition time.
full_list.abstract_zh: 纳米 FTIR 光谱将红外光谱与纳米级空间分辨率相结合，实现高光谱纳米成像。然而，定量测量通常依赖于高次谐波近场信号，这些信号基本上没有背景，但信噪比 (SNR) 较低。较低的谐波可提供更高的信噪比，但包含显着的背景影响，会扭曲近场响应并阻碍定量分析。在这里，我们引入了一种交叉谐波神经网络（CHNN），它利用多个谐波通道中编码的互补信息来对三次谐波高光谱数据进行去噪。 CHNN 直接在实验纳米 FTIR 数据集上进行训练，使用一次和二次谐波光谱来提高三次谐波响应的 SNR。

full_list.title_en: Fine-tuned atomistic foundation model for accurate sodium-carbon chemistry in Na-ion batteries
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Fine-tuned atomistic foundation model for accurate sodium-carbon chemistry in Na-ion batteries
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18490v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Atomistic foundation models have emerged as a promising route to DFT-level accuracy for materials simulation with complex chemical environments. However, their reliability across competing bonding regimes and, more importantly, how complex bonding affects predictions of material properties remain unclear. Among materials with competing bonding regimes, sodium storage in hard carbon poses a substantial challenge. Hard carbon features diverse local structural motifs, including defective and curved graphitic regions, amorphous regions, and closed/open pores. Motivated by its importance for Na-ion batteries, we systematically evaluate existing pretrained foundation models based on the MACE architecture across different local Na/C motifs. We find that the pretrained models fail to accurately capture Na-Na and Na-C interactions for metallic Na clusters on graphene. To recover a DFT-level energetic description, we employ targeted fine-tuning, showing that it can describe the energetic stability of local motifs and achieve sufficient transferability to unseen Na/C environments. With the developed fine-tuned model, we establish a correlation between closed-pore radius in hard carbon and plateau voltage, showing that the small pores contribute at larger voltages than large ones, suggesting thus how the developed fine-tuned foundation model can link atomistic information with materials design for complex bonding environments.

full_list.title_en: Diffusion Tree Sampling for Inference Time Adaptation of Crystal Generative Models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Diffusion Tree Sampling for Inference Time Adaptation of Crystal Generative Models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models have become strong priors over plausible crystal structures, but turning that prior into promising candidates requires steering toward several conflicting properties at once. Fine-tuning is expensive and produces a new model for every new objective, while differentiable guidance is not applicable to many real-world tasks. We instead adapt these generative models at inference time using Diffusion Tree Sampling (DTS), a Monte Carlo tree search procedure over the denoising trajectory. We make two technical contributions on top of DTS that are particularly relevant for AI-for-science applications. First, we show how to use existing property-conditional generative models (e.g., models fine-tuned for classifier-free guidance) as guided proposals inside DTS, without distorting the target distribution. Second, we extend DTS to multi-objective sampling, so that a single search produces samples spanning an entire Pareto front. We instantiate both adaptations on de novo crystal generation: improving the stability of crystals generated by different models, using pretrained conditional models to generate crystals belonging to rare space groups or with high bulk modulus, and generating crystals along a Pareto front of high dielectric constant and high bandgap materials. Across these tasks, DTS-based inference-time adaptation successfully improves model outputs without modifying the models themselves.

full_list.title_en: Bridging surface dynamics and phase transitions in CsPbI₃ perovskite with machine-learning force fields and dispersion interactions

full_list.abstract: Author(s): Iryna Knysh, Anton Charkin-Gorbulin, Claudio Quarti, David Beljonne, Igor Poltavsky, and Alexandre Tkatchenko Can a machine learning model trained on surface slabs accurately describe bulk phase transitions? The authors demonstrate this with a model trained on cubic CsPbI 3 slab configurations that reproduces the temperature-driven orthorhombic-tetragonal-cubic phase transitions in bulk CsPbI 3 . The authors show that the choice between pairwise and beyond-pairwise dispersion treatments significantly affects the predicted phase transitions. The authors attribute these differences to the strong sensitivity of Cs and I atomic forces to the treatment of van der Waals dispersion. Their findings highlight the potential of surface-trained machine learning models for transferable atomistic simulations and the crucial role of dispersion interactions in perovskite dynamics. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 113802] Published Mon Nov 16, 2026

full_list.title_en: Machine-learning charge density for electronic materials and devices simulation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine-learning charge density for electronic materials and devices simulation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a machine-learning (ML) charge density model, DeltaChargeNet, integrated with the full-potential tight-binding muffin-tin orbital (FP-TB-MTO) method for electronic structure and quantum transport simulations of materials and devices. The ML model predicts electron density from atomic structures with low linear-scaling cost, while FP-TB-MTO provides an accurate tight-binding representation of the system Hamiltonian. To achieve high-fidelity ML density for complex devices with interfaces and disorder, we train an equivariant graph convolutional network to predict Δ ρ-the difference between DFT and atomic superposition densities-under a charge neutrality constraint required for inhomogeneous systems. A secondary ML residual charge model compensates for errors in the primary Δ ρ model. The predicted density is then used within the full-relativistic FP-TB-MTO framework combined with the non-equilibrium Green's function method. We validate our method on bulk HgCdTe disordered alloys (including vacancy defects) and Au/HgCdTe/Au disordered devices. The maximum band energy error is below 10 meV for bulk HgCdTe. For devices, the charge neutrality constraint suppresses long-wavelength charge bias that would otherwise distort the electrostatic potential by 0.68-1.88 eV near the device center, while residual compensation corrects the remaining 0.16-0.46 eV potential mismatch, essential for reproducing the correct potential barrier profile. Together, these corrections reproduce the layer-resolved potential, including interface steps and bulk-like plateaus, within 0.1 eV of fully self-consistent DFT. Finally, we demonstrate quantum transport in a 11220-atom infrared detector. By combining first-principles accuracy with linear-scaling inference, DeltaChargeNet enables large-scale device simulations without the full DFT self-consistent field loop.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示, 第一性原理标注与结构优化, 有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: CGTransformer: A Topology-Aware Autoregressive Framework for Crystal Generation and Inverse Design
full_list.title_zh: CGTransformer：用于晶体生成和逆设计的拓扑感知自回归框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autoregressive language models offer a unified route to crystal generation and inverse design, but their performance depends on how periodic structures are serialized. Symmetry equivalent and closely related crystals can receive different atomic orders under coordinate-based serialization, introducing variability unrelated to their structural connectivity. Here, we present CGTransformer (Crystal Graph Transformer), an autoregressive generative framework that addresses this challenge via a graph-embedded sorting strategy. Using quotientgraph topology and barycentric embeddings, Element Symmetry Graph (ESG) converts periodic crystal networks into topology-guided one-dimensional sequences that retain key local and symmetry-related structural information. CGTransformer achieves high generation validity and the highest single shot crystal structure prediction (CSP) match rate among the compared MP-20 baselines (63.24%), while same backbone comparisons show improved structure recovery over coordinate-based ordering. Furthermore, we demonstrate property-conditioned inverse design for wide-bandgap semiconductors, where ESG achieves a much higher stable, unique and novel (S.U.N.) rate and stronger target-property alignment than the coordinate-based baseline. These results establish topology-guided sequence construction as an effective route to improving crystal generation and property-directed design at fixed model capacity.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自回归语言模型提供了晶体生成和逆向设计的统一途径，但其性能取决于周期性结构的序列化方式。对称等效且密切相关的晶体可以在基于坐标的序列化下接收不同的原子顺序，从而引入与其结构连接性无关的可变性。在这里，我们提出了 CGTransformer（Crystal Graph Transformer），这是一种自回归生成框架，它通过图嵌入排序策略来解决这一挑战。使用商图拓扑和重心嵌入，元素对称图 (ESG) 将周期性晶体网络转换为拓扑引导的一维序列，保留关键的局部和对称相关的结构信息。

full_list.title_en: A Machine-learning-aided Workflow for Sampling Small Polaron Dynamics in Energy Materials
full_list.title_zh: 一种用于对能源材料中的小极化子动力学进行采样的机器学习辅助工作流程
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18041v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One of the defining characteristics of most energy materials, used as e.g.~battery electrodes, photovoltaics, or photocatalysts, is their ability conduct charges such as electrons and holes. The exact mechanism of this conductivity depends on the material, but is often dominated by the existence of mobile small polarons, i.e.~electrons or holes strongly localised through the polarisation of their environment. Computationally, small polarons can be treated with reasonably accuracy through the use of self-interaction corrected or hybrid density functional theory (DFT) together with local geometry optimisation. Similar approaches can be employed to determine the energy barriers to movement of the polarons through hopping. Unfortunately, realistic energy materials tend have very large numbers of symmetry inequivalent polaronic configurations and correspondingly large numbers of hopping barriers, making them hard to tackle explicitly. In this work we therefore extend the computational reach of DFT calculations with machine-learned (ML) surrogate models, which then feed into a kinetic model to quantitatively estimate the conductivity of a battery anode material (Li₄Ti₅O₁₂ or LTO) at realistic, defected conditions. We calculate the conductivity at room temperature to be 6.7 × 10⁻³ S/cm which lies well in the experimental range. To this end, we only needed a total of 154 polaron barrier calculations, out of 3649 symmetry inequivalent ones, achieving an over 20-fold increase of computational efficiency. Overall, our work demonstrates how DFT-trained ML surrogates can be used to quantitatively and efficiently sample the dynamics of small polarons in energy materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 大多数能量材料（例如用作电池电极、光伏材料或光催化剂）的一个显著特征是其能够传导电荷，如电子和空穴。这种导电性的确切机制取决于材料，但通常由移动小极化子的存在主导，即通过其环境的极化而强烈局域化的电子或空穴。在计算方面，可以通过使用自相互作用校正或混合密度泛函理论（DFT）以及局部几何优化，以合理的精度处理小极化子。可以采用类似的方法来确定小极化子通过跃迁运动的能垒。遗憾的是，现实的能源材料往往具有非常大量的对称性不等价的极化子构型，以及相应的大量跃迁势垒，因此难以明确处理。

full_list.title_en: Enrichment-Oriented Virtual Screening of Perovskite Solar Cells through Reinforcement Learning
full_list.title_zh: 通过强化学习对钙钛矿太阳能电池进行面向富集的虚拟筛选
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18043v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experimental optimization of perovskite solar cells is constrained by combinatorial diversity in absorber compositions, device layers, and processing, which makes virtual screening attractive for prioritizing recipes before fabrication. We develop a surrogate-guided reinforcement-learning framework that casts recipe generation as virtual screening, enriching candidate shortlists near high-performing experimental neighbors. A frozen Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) guides recipe generation, while a reference pool of 890 measured devices enables neighborhood-based assessment. Five-fold evaluation on 1,846 devices shows top-ten selection raises mean power conversion efficiency (PCE) from 19.68% to 23.74%. Three learned policies are compared with six baselines under 3,000 surrogate evaluations per run. In top-100 shortlists, Proximal policy optimization (PPO) and recurrent PPO (RPPO) achieve neighborhood-supported hit rates of 23% and 24% (7.9- and 8.3-fold Pure Random's 2.9%), versus 10% (3.4-fold) for the baselines with the highest supported hit rate (L-SHADE and Ax BO, tied) at K = 100. Gains coexist with weak-support fractions. Of 9,000 recipes, 65.4% match a composition family at similarity 0.80, falling to 11.7% at 0.90. Results support enrichment-oriented prioritization but not experimental performance, seed robustness, or matched-budget advantage.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：强化学习和闭环控制。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《通过强化学习对钙钛矿太阳能电池进行面向富集的虚拟筛选》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Data-driven exploration of the strength-ductility synergy in refractory high-entropy alloys
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Data-driven exploration of the strength-ductility synergy in refractory high-entropy alloys
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) have attracted increasing attention for their exceptional ability to retain strength at high temperatures. However, current research mainly concentrates on compositions close to equimolar alloys, leaving a large part of the composition space unexplored. Here, we develop a multiscale framework based on a data-driven dislocation genome method that constructs energy landscapes for edge dislocation motion across various compositions. The local configurational force derived from the energy landscape is incorporated into dislocation dynamics simulations, revealing a scaling law connecting macroscale strength and atomic-scale local resistance governed by fluctuations in the local configurational force. Based on this scaling law, a new solid-solution strengthening model for edge dislocation in BCC alloys is developed, followed by a data-driven exploration of refractory alloys considering both strength and ductility. The developed method and theory are adaptable, allowing for extension to other BCC alloy systems and guiding high-throughput alloy design.
full_list.summary: Refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) have attracted increasing attention for their exceptional ability to retain strength at high temperatures. However, current research mainly concentrates on compo…
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“用 ML 代理能量和不确定性缩小结构搜索，再对候选做对称性、动力学稳定性、极化/磁序和有限温度筛选，避免只按 0 K 单点能排序”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到新型铁电、磁性、钙钛矿、二维和能源材料候选。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在新型铁电、磁性、钙钛矿、二维和能源材料候选中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“用 ML 代理能量和不确定性缩小结构搜索，再对候选做对称性、动力学稳定性、极化/磁序和有限温度筛选，避免只按 0 K 单点能排序”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Data-driven exploration of the strength-ductility synergy in refractory high-entropy alloys》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: AI for Parameter Selection in Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
full_list.title_zh: 基于样本的量子对角化中参数选择的人工智能
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) methods provide a way to compute molecular ground-state energies, but their accuracy and runtime depend sensitively on configuration choices such as the subspace dimension, propagation timestep, and the allocation of a fixed sampling budget across circuits, for which no formal selection method exists. In this work, we explore whether oracle models can predict the quantum runtime and approximation error from the Hamiltonian and the candidate configuration. Using synthetic Hamiltonians with controllable spectral properties, we show that machine-learned models can map a Hamiltonian directly to the best-ranked configuration within a predefined grid for the SKQD algorithm, validated against classical Krylov propagation, achieving strong rank correlations between true and predicted error and runtime, Spearman ρ = 0.969 and ρ = 0.905, respectively. Extending the approach to 50 molecular Hamiltonians (20-50 qubits), with reference ground-state energies from classical calculations, we train regressors that predict the simulation error and runtime for a given molecule--configuration pair ahead of execution, and classifiers to distinguish, from 600 SqDRIFT quantum-hardware runs, whether a configuration achieves a ground-state energy within chemical accuracy (1.6×10⁻³ Ha approx 1 kcal/mol). For the molecular Hamiltonians, the models additionally provide an a priori feasibility and resource estimate, predicting whether a molecule can reach chemical accuracy on current hardware and at what runtime, thus correctly classifying held-out molecules at the molecule level, achieving balanced accuracy 61.8% in-distribution and 100% for five larger held-out molecules.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法提供了一种计算分子基态能量的方法，但其准确性和运行时间敏感地取决于配置选择，例如子空间维度、传播时间步长以及跨电路的固定采样预算分配，而对于这些配置选择不存在正式的选择方法。在这项工作中，我们探索预言模型是否可以根据哈密顿量和候选配置预测量子运行时间和近似误差。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法提供了一种计算分子基态能量的方法，但其准确性和运行时间敏感地取决于配置选择，例如子空间维度、传播时间步长以及跨电路的固定采样预算分配，而对于这些配置选择不存在正式的选择方法。在这项工作中，我们探索预言模型是否可以根据哈密顿量和候选配置预测量子运行时间和近似误差。使用具有可控谱特性的合成哈密顿量，我们表明机器学习模型可以将哈密顿量直接映射到 SKQD 算法预定义网格内的最佳排名配置，并针对经典 Krylov 传播进行验证，实现真实误差和预测误差与运行时间之间的强排名相关性，分别为 Spearman ρ = 0.969 和 ρ = 0.905。将方法扩展到 50 个分子哈密顿量（20-50 个量子位），利用经典计算中的参考基态能量，我们训练回归器，在执行之前预测给定分子配置对的模拟误差和运行时间，并训练分类器，以从 600 SqDRIFT 量子硬件运行中区分配置是否在化学精度内实现基态能量（1.6×10⁻³ Ha 约 1）千卡/摩尔）。对于分子哈密顿量，该模型还提供了先验可行性和资源估计，预测分子是否可以在当前硬件上以及运行时达到化学精度，从而在分子水平上正确分类保留分子，实现分布内 61.8% 的平衡精度和五个较大保留分子 100% 的平衡精度。

full_list.title_en: Regularized Neural Quantum States for Heisenberg Magnets
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Regularized Neural Quantum States for Heisenberg Magnets
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an approach to solving locally ordered quantum spin systems using neural network quantum states. First, our approach rests on choosing a spin basis constructed from the magnetic texture of a classical or quantum reference state. Second, the method improves convergence and suppresses parameter-space drift through a regularized Riemannian gradient descent adapted to the quantum state geometry of the variational state manifold. Combining these techniques enables stable ground-state calculations for two- and three-dimensional chiral spin systems with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions. The resulting variational ground-state energies are competitive with those of high-fidelity density matrix renormalization group calculations and, for periodic and layered geometries, provide significantly tighter upper bounds on the ground-state energy.

full_list.title_en: Foundation Tensor Networks Generalize Across Quantum Lattice Systems
full_list.title_zh: 基础张量网络在量子晶格系统中推广
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural quantum states and tensor networks have emerged as leading techniques for simulating quantum many-body systems. However, disordered systems remain extremely challenging in both frameworks as they require computation of the ground state for every realization of the disorder. Recently, neural quantum states have been used to construct foundation models that generate the ground state directly from the Hamiltonian. Still, they are hindered by the need to perform extensive sampling to estimate observables. To address these difficulties, we introduce the foundation tensor network (FTN), which uses a neural network to generate the tensor network representation of the ground-state wavefunction from the Hamiltonian. To accelerate training, we develop a technique, called textttGridBP, based on iterated one-dimensional belief propagation that reduces the cost of computing the energy expectation value to just two tensor contractions. We use FTNs to calculate the critical parameters of the glass transition in the quantum Edwards-Anderson model via finite-size scaling analysis. To facilitate rapid averaging, we use a moment-generating function to evaluate the order parameter, lowering the cost to a single tensor contraction. We obtain high-fidelity estimates for the critical parameters by averaging over 500,000 disorder realizations.

full_list.title_en: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous crystal-structure determination from powder X-ray diffraction (pXRD) remains a key bottleneck for self-driving materials laboratories. We formulate the task of pXRD structure determination as a verifiable agentic search problem: candidate structures can be assessed during inference through forward-simulated profile agreement and during evaluation through structural matching to a known reference. To benchmark progress, we introduce pXRD-Bench, a suite of 200 simulated single-phase problems spanning in-distribution structure determination, challenging and polymorphic structures, and controlled compositional and topological distribution shifts. Agent adaptation raises selected structural recovery from 27% to 69%, with further gains from repeated sampling and verifier-guided inference-time scaling. We extend this approach to experimental multiphase pXRD through a reflexive evolution framework that learns from self-generated synthetic problems. A replaceable laboratory specification defines the sample family and measurement conditions. An evolver agent uses the known generating structures and measurement parameters to diagnose solver failures and develop persistent guidance and executable tools, which are then provided to agents on measured patterns. This supplies verifiable training experience without requiring a collection of solved experimental measurements. On 15 measured patterns from solid-state synthesis, the evolved package improves average profile agreement and transfers an analogue-substitution procedure that recovers a phase whose structure is absent from the supplied reference library. These results demonstrate how learning from verifiable synthetic experience can improve agentic characterization of experimental samples whose structures are not known in advance.

full_list.title_en: Topology-based fast neutron background suppression and sterile-neutrino sensitivity in a segmented reactor overlineνₑ detector
full_list.title_zh: 分段反应堆上线νₑ探测器中基于拓扑的快中子背景抑制和惰性中微子灵敏度
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17348v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reactor electron antineutrinos are commonly detected through the inverse beta decay interaction, with a prompt positron followed by delayed neutron capture. In shallow or above-ground segmented organic scintillator detectors, correlated fast neutrons are a dominant background because proton recoils can mimic the prompt IBD signal. We study topology-based machine learning using the Indian Scintillator Matrix for Reactor Anti-Neutrinos detector as a case study. A multilayer perceptron is trained on reconstructed topological observables from detailed Geant4 simulations. The mathrmF₁ score and bootstrap resampling on an independent validation sample yield a fixed threshold of PIBD>0.40. Applied without further optimization to an independent testing sample, the MLP retains (83.4± 0.7)% of IBD events and rejects (77.3± 0.7)% of fast neutron events. In a controlled spectral benchmark using an independent AmBe fast neutron spectrum, the selection reduces the net candidate-spectrum deformation by 84%. The energy dependent signal acceptance and residual fast neutron component are subsequently incorporated into a binned likelihood, which recovers the injected IBD signal strength as mathrmhatα=0.993⁺⁰.⁰⁵³₋₀.₀₄₈, with an empirical goodness-of-fit probability of 0.434. The expected sterile-neutrino sensitivity for the ISMRAN detector is evaluated at baselines of 13 m and 18 m, with two years of exposure at each baseline. For the nominal pre-MLP S/B=1:2 benchmark and the background model, retaining the classifier score in a joint (mathrmEₚᵣₒₘₚₜ× PIBD) likelihood improves the 95% C.L. sensitivity to sin²2θ₁₄ by a logarithmically averaged 7.9% over 0.1≤Δ m₄₁²≤1~eV² relative to an energy-only likelihood with the same fast neutron contamination.

full_list.title_en: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fast charging of lithium-ion batteries is a multi-objective control problem that requires reducing charging time and sustaining high energy throughput while suppressing accelerated degradation and safety-critical electrochemical reactions. Conventional protocols are easy to implement but have limited ability to adapt to variations in battery chemistry, operating conditions, and aging state. Model-based optimization and conventional data-driven control often require accurate models, costly iterative search, or task-specific policies. We develop a large language model (LLM)-empowered intelligent agent for adaptive battery fast-charging control. In this closed-loop framework, the agent interprets structured battery states, generates executable charging actions, observes the resulting battery response, and continuously adjusts subsequent decisions. We construct a large-scale simulation corpus with PyBaMM across five battery chemistries and 11 parameter sets and convert the resulting state-action-response trajectories into structured process data for agent training. Our two-stage strategy combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). SFT establishes battery-control semantics and feasible decision priors from simulation-derived demonstrations. GRPO aligns the agent with a multi-objective control objective covering energy throughput, degradation mitigation, and operational constraints. Closed-loop simulations show that, under matched energy-throughput requirements, the agent achieves longer cycling life than conventional charging baselines and optimization-based strategies across heterogeneous battery configurations. This study provides a simulation-grounded proof of concept for using LLM agents as sequential decision makers in battery management and takes a step toward language-model-enabled control of physical energy systems.

full_list.title_en: Geometric diabatization via learned parallel transport of electronic states
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Geometric diabatization via learned parallel transport of electronic states
full_list.abstract: We present a machine-learning framework for diabatization based on the parallel transport of electronic states. Starting from a differential-geometric description of the Born–Oppenheimer approximation, we learn the generator of a continuous unitary transformation between adiabatic and quasi-diabatic electronic states. The generator is represented by a neural network and integrated along nuclear paths using a neural ordinary differential equation. Sparse non-adiabatic coupling data are used to train the local transport, while the more densely available adiabatic energies are included through an energy-weighted regularization term. This avoids fitting the adiabatic potential energy surfaces directly and preserves both orthonormality and the adiabatic energy spectrum by construction. The method is demonstrated for an analytically solvable two-state model with a conical intersection, the ionic–neutral avoided crossing in LiF, and a two-dimensional cut through the conical intersection of NO 2 . The examples show the construction of quasi-diabatic representations under explicitly specified geometric path conventions.

full_list.title_en: Pressure and Magnetic Field Control of Topology in Antiferromagnetic Bilayers
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Pressure and Magnetic Field Control of Topology in Antiferromagnetic Bilayers
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling band topology in magnetic semiconductors requires strategies that couple electronic structure to experimentally accessible degrees of freedom. Here we propose a cooperative approach based on pressure and magnetic reorientation in A-type antiferromagnetic bilayers. Antiparallel layer magnetizations suppress hybridization between exchange-polarized band-edge states, limiting their response to interlayer compression. A magnetic field that aligns the layer moments removes this spin mismatch, enabling pressure-enhanced hybridization to drive a band inversion. The magnetization direction then controls the symmetries of the inverted bands and whether spin--orbit coupling produces a Chern-insulating gap or symmetry-protected nodal crossings. First-principles calculations for bilayer CrSBr illustrate this mechanism within a compressed orthorhombic structural model. Out-of-plane magnetization yields a Chern insulator with a chiral edge state, whereas in-plane magnetization supports a two-dimensional Weyl semimetal with node-connecting edge states. Continuous spin canting further demonstrates how magnetic reorientation can drive the transition and stabilize the Chern phase before full magnetic saturation. Although material-specific transition conditions depend on electronic correlations and structural stability under compression, the underlying strategy identifies interlayer hybridization as a link between magnetic order and band topology. These results provide a design principle for externally tunable topological phases in layered antiferromagnetic semiconductors.

full_list.title_en: Quantitative Impact of Occupation Smearing Methods on Conventional Superconductivity: from Electronic Structure through Lattice Dynamics to Electron-Phonon Coupling
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantitative Impact of Occupation Smearing Methods on Conventional Superconductivity: from Electronic Structure through Lattice Dynamics to Electron-Phonon Coupling
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.18185v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In first-principles calculations of metallic systems, the discrete electronic mesh in the Brillouin zone necessitates a smearing function and its width (e.g., the widely used 0.02 Ry Methfessel-Paxton scheme) to enforce continuity of energy and occupation at the Fermi surface. However, the quantitative impact of such empirical parameters on phonon-mediated superconductivity has long been overlooked, leading to their habitual selection by mere convention. Here, using hexahydride CsH6 as a benchmark, we systematically investigate the magnitude and propagation mechanism of smearing-induced errors against the parameter-free optimized tetrahedron method. Long-tailed smearing delocalizes the occupation window, causing substantial Fermi-level shifts, flattening of the density of states, and hardening phonon modes, thereby weakening electron-phonon coupling. Conversely, short-tailed smearing suffers from insufficient sampling, producing density-of-states oscillations and enhanced Fermi-surface nesting. These artifacts amplify electronic screening and Peierls instabilities, which soften acoustic modes and generate imaginary frequencies, causing CsH6 to be dynamically unstable and discarded. However, the optimized tetrahedron method reveals that CsH6 is dynamically stable under ambient pressure with a remarkable superconducting transition temperature of 121 K. To prevent subjective empirical parameters from obscuring theoretically promising high-temperature superconductors, we derive a simple scaling relation for the smearing width, applicable to different smearing functions, from the free-electron-gas model, offering an objective, precise, and efficient protocol for parameter selection in high-throughput screening.

full_list.title_en: Composition Driven Band Alignment Evolution in Grafted Si/GeSn Heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Composition Driven Band Alignment Evolution in Grafted Si/GeSn Heterostructures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding and controlling band alignment in lattice-mismatched group-IV semiconductor-based heterostructures is fundamental to rational band-structure engineering, as it governs the electronic structure and carrier transport in heterointegrated semiconductor systems. Despite growing interest in Si/GeSn heterostructures, the composition-dependent band alignment has not been experimentally established. Here, we experimentally establish the evolution of band alignment in semiconductor-grafted Si/GeSn heterostructures with contents ranging from 8.8% to 12.4% using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and Kraut's core-level method. The valence-band offset increases systematically from ~0.29 to ~0.57 eV with increasing Sn composition, whereas the corresponding effective conduction-band offset decreases from ~0.30 to ~0.12 eV. The observed band-alignment evolution is attributed to an upward shift of the GeSn valence-band maximum arising from enhanced p-p orbital hybridization, reduced bonding-antibonding splitting, and compressive-strain-induced heavy-hole band lifting. These findings establish the experimental relationship between alloy composition and interfacial band alignment in semiconductor-grafted Si/GeSn heterostructures, providing a quantitative framework for rational band-structure engineering in lattice-mismatched group-IV semiconductor heterostructures.

full_list.title_en: Controlled Magnon Chirality and Its Reversal by Anisotropy in Altermagnetic FeF₂
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Controlled Magnon Chirality and Its Reversal by Anisotropy in Altermagnetic FeF₂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18182v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In altermagnets, the exchange symmetry of two mutually compensating magnetic sublattices permits spin-polarized electronic bands and chirality-split magnon bands. Because these effects have opposite signs in domains related by time reversal, magnetic-domain control is essential for their observation and utilization. Using half-polarized neutron diffraction, we demonstrate that we can control magnetic domain imbalance in a single crystal of FeF₂ by field cooling, and we relate this response to the established piezomagnetism in this material. Our half-polarized inelastic neutron scattering measurements directly resolve the altermagnetic splitting of chiral magnon bands. Strikingly, we observe a clear reversal of chirality near Q=(0.5,0.5,1), where the altermagnetic exchange splitting vanishes and no chirality is expected in a nonrelativistic exchange model. This reversal of the chirality is well explained by the presence of a transverse component of the single-ion anisotropy tensor, which rotates between Fe sublattices related by the crystal's altermagnetic 4₂ screw symmetry. These results allow us to resolve fine features of the spin Hamiltonian for FeF₂ and show how symmetry-governed relativistic anisotropy can reshape altermagnetic spin dynamics, as well as providing an avenue for control of magnetic domains and the net chiral response.

full_list.title_en: Exotic superconducting states in altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Exotic superconducting states in altermagnets
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2507.10700v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between magnetism and superconductivity is one of the central topics of condensed matter physics, which has recently been put into new light by the discovery of altermagnets. Here, we study this interplay from a fundamental symmetry perspective using irreducible co-representations of the altermagnetic spin-point groups. We construct and tabulate all symmetry-allowed pairing functions for altermagnets, which uncovers numerous exotic pairing states. We focus on three of them, namely: (i) a non-unitary ``altermagnetic superconductor'' with different spatial anisotropies for the spin-up and spin-down condensates, (ii) a ``half-and-half metal-superconductor" where only electrons with one of the two spin components form Cooper pairs, and (iii) a ``spin chiral superconductor'' with spin-polarized chiral edge states. Interestingly, the first of these three superconductors exhibits an unusual fractional ac Josephson current for only one of the two spin polarizations, even though the two condensates are symmetry related. We present phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau theories for these unconventional superconductors and show that they correspond to stable minima of the free energies. We examine their topological properties, study the effects of small spin-orbit coupling, consider possible material examples, and investigate their topological responses.

full_list.title_en: Finite-Larmor-radius vortex interaction from δf to full-f gyrofluid dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 从δf到全f回旋流体动力学的有限拉莫半径涡流相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study finite-size electrostatic gyrofluid vortex pairs in a two-dimensional isothermal model, focusing on finite-Larmor-radius effects and the transition from local perturbative to finite-amplitude full-distribution dynamics. An effective response kernel based on Padé ion gyroaveraging regularizes the short-range Euler interaction on the Larmor-radius scale while preserving its logarithmic far field, yielding a finite- core prediction for the orbital frequency. Local-model scans show that increasing the ion temperature relative to the electron temperature enhances gyrospinning and filamentation and drives a separation-dependent transition from merger to long-lived co-rotation. Long-wavelength simulations reproduce the predicted finite-Larmor- radius-induced dip in orbital angular frequency, corresponding to a pronounced slowdown of the vortex-pair rotation. For the full-distribution regime, we introduce a quasi-neutrality-consistent initialization that reconstructs the ion gyrocenter density from prescribed electron density and electrostatic potential. It recovers the local limit at small amplitude, whereas finite-amplitude simulations reveal additional mean-density polarization vorticity, delayed or arrested merger, and a loss of density- vorticity sign symmetry already in the cold-ion full-f system. An independent sign scan of density and vorticity then shows how this nonlinear NOB asymmetry combines with the local warm-ion FLR symmetry breaking identified in earlier δf vortex studies; for warm ions, Padé-based arbitrary-wavelength NOB and NOB+LWL polarization additionally produce distinct morphologies and trajectories. These results demonstrate that nonlinear density-dependent polarization and FLR physics form separate but coupled mechanisms that can qualitatively alter elementary vortex interactions in two-dimensional gyrofluid dynamics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究二维等温模型中的有限尺寸静电陀螺流体涡流对，重点关注有限拉莫尔半径效应以及从局部微扰到有限幅度全分布动力学的转变。基于帕德离子陀螺平均的有效响应核在拉莫尔半径尺度上正则化短程欧拉相互作用，同时保留其对数远场，从而产生轨道频率的有限核心预测。局部模型扫描表明，增加相对于电子温度的离子温度会增强陀螺旋转和丝状化，并驱动从合并到长寿命共同旋转的分离依赖性转变。长波长模拟再现了预测的有限拉莫尔半径引起的轨道角频率下降，对应于涡旋对旋转的明显减慢。

full_list.title_en: Intertwined Orders, Quantum Criticality and Skyrmions in Tunable Topological Bands
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Intertwined Orders, Quantum Criticality and Skyrmions in Tunable Topological Bands
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.21913v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Skyrmions are emergent many-body excitations that lie at the heart of both multi-component quantum Hall-like systems and deconfined quantum criticality. In a companion article (X. Wang et al., arXiv:2507.22971), we studied a microscopic time-reversal symmetric model of tunable interacting Chern bands using numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo calculations, and presented evidence for the emergence of robust skyrmion excitations. These charged excitations emerge in the vicinity of a many-body insulator at a commensurate filling of the Chern bands, and lead to the onset of superconductivity when doped away from the insulating phase. Here, we present quantum Monte-Carlo results and a complementary field-theoretical analysis for the quantum phase transition(s) that arise between the intertwined phases as a function of two distinct tuning parameters. Our numerical results are consistent with a single continuous quantum phase transition between an insulating Chern antiferromagnet and a fully gapped superconductor, with an emergent SO(5) symmetry at the putative critical point, highly suggestive of deconfined quantum (pseudo-)criticality. We also present a detailed comparison between the momentum-resolved spectral functions associated with the neutral collective modes, single electron and composite spin-polaron excitations obtained using a combination of Monte-Carlo computations and a Bethe-Salpeter analysis built on top of the self-consistent Hartree-Fock calculation. We end with a brief outlook on some of the interesting open problems.

full_list.title_en: Narrow-Band Magnetism Allowed by Quantum Geometry: Altermagnetism and Beyond
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Narrow-Band Magnetism Allowed by Quantum Geometry: Altermagnetism and Beyond
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17414v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry plays a central role in shaping correlated phases in narrow bands, yet its influence on the competition between distinct magnetic orders, especially the emergence of altermagnetism, remains largely unexplored. To address this question, we study the quadrupole insulator model with strictly onsite generalized Hubbard-Kanamori interactions, in which both Néel antiferromagnetism and altermagnetism are symmetry-permitted. Depending on the parameters, the isolated narrow lowest band of the model can either be obstructed atomic with strong quantum geometry or trivial atomic with weak quantum geometry, while the dispersion is identical in the two cases. By partially filling the lowest band, our Hartree-Fock calculations show only conventional ferromagnetic phases for the weak quantum geometric case, while we find two collinear altermagnetic phases, as well as nematic phases, for the strong quantum geometric case. Such a dramatic difference can be understood by the distinct characters of the projected interaction: the projected interactions acquire sizable longer-range channels only for the strong quantum geometric case, while they are dominated by the on-site Hubbard channel in the weak quantum geometric case. These results establish the essential role of quantum geometry for altermagnetism to emerge from interacting narrow bands where crystalline symmetries cannot sufficiently constrain the magnetic order.

full_list.title_en: Reconciling global and local spin models
full_list.title_zh: 协调全球和本地自旋模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18207v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic interactions based on first-principles calculations can be casted either into global spin models, where the interactions are configuration-independent, or into local spin models, where the effective parameters depend explicitly on the underlying spin configuration. Although these two perspectives often yield seemingly inconsistent results, we demonstrate that they can be reconciled by restricting the analysis to transverse spin fluctuations. We develop a projection scheme that systematically removes spurious longitudinal contributions from local interaction matrices, thereby establishing a rigorous connection between the projected local interactions and the underlying global multispin Hamiltonian. Applying our approach to the prototype systems (i) a Cr trimer on Au(111) (ii) Fe and Cr dimers on Cu(001), we show that the projected local interaction parameters quantitatively reproduce those obtained from the global four-spin model. This work provides a unified framework to interpret local and global spin models on equal footing and resolves long-standing ambiguities in the identification of effective interactions such as the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) in a non-collinear framework.

full_list.title_en: Uniaxial strain induces d-wave phonon chirality in ferroelectric BaTiO₃
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Uniaxial strain induces d-wave phonon chirality in ferroelectric BaTiO₃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circularly dichroic resonant inelastic x-ray scattering has revealed electrically switchable g-wave phonon chirality in freestanding BaTiO₃ membranes. Here, we show from first principles that uniaxial strain changes the angular class of this texture. Lowering C₄ᵥ to C₂ᵥ adds a d-wave helicity that is bilinear in the orthorhombic strain η and the polarization, with nodal lines along the stress axis. For the 38~meV branches at η=1%, we find that (i) along the diagonal, where the helicity vanishes by symmetry without strain, it reaches about 60% of the unstrained maximum, and (ii) at the measured wave vectors off the mirror it is reduced by more than half. With PBEsol and PBE+D3 force constants, the d-wave component grows linearly in η and equals the g-wave one at η^*approx1.3--1.4%. Resolved by branch, the response of strain-split E doublets is non-analytic in η, as captured by a two-band model. Strain therefore provides a second knob, besides the electric field, that controls the symmetry and the sign of phonon chirality in ferroelectric membranes.

full_list.title_en: Vestiges of magnon fractionalization in the quasi-two-dimensional quantum magnet rouaite Cu₂(NO₃)(OH)₃ with alternating ferro- and antiferromagnetic S=frac12 chains
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Vestiges of magnon fractionalization in the quasi-two-dimensional quantum magnet rouaite Cu₂(NO₃)(OH)₃ with alternating ferro- and antiferromagnetic S=frac12 chains
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferro- and antiferromagnetic quantum spin chains host qualitatively distinct elementary excitations --- magnons (S=1, bosonic quasiparticles) and spinons (S=frac12, fractionalized quasiparticles), respectively. Weakly coupled networks of both chain types therefore provide an ideal platform for exploring spinon-magnon coupling and the hybridization of sharp magnon modes with spinon continua. Here we investigate the spin-excitation spectrum of the frustrated quantum magnet rouaite, Cu₂(NO₃)(OH)₃ --- a model realization of weakly coupled ferro- and antiferromagnetic Cu²⁺ spin-frac12 chains. The frustrated interchain interactions, while weaker than the dominant intrachain exchange, are sufficient to stabilize a long-range-ordered state that is not reproduced by classical calculations. Neutron spectroscopy reveals a spectrum of well-defined spin waves associated with both types of chains, with clear signatures of hybridization but no observable spinon continuum. Certain magnon branches resulting from this hybridization exhibit substantial broadening near the zone center. We attribute this to vestiges of spinon fractionalization persisting partway through the dimensional crossover from isolated quantum spin chains to a 2D network of frustrated spins.

full_list.title_en: Altermagnetism across the BCS-BEC crossover
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Altermagnetism across the BCS-BEC crossover
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.14613v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study a two-dimensional paired Fermi system in which altermagnetism produces a spin splitting that depends on momentum. The interaction strength is described through the two-body binding energy, so that the chemical potential and pairing gap evolve self-consistently from the weak-coupling Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) regime to the strong-coupling Bose-Einstein-condensate (BEC) regime at fixed density. The stability of the uniform paired state is examined by giving the pairs a small center-of-mass momentum and following the resulting change in free energy. We show that at zero temperature, the phase stiffness follows a universal quadratic suppression, J/J₀ = 1 - (α/α₀)², across the entire fully gapped crossover regime. Deviations from this relation emerge only on the BCS side upon the opening of gapless Bogoliubov pockets, which rapidly reduce the stiffness and can trigger an instability toward finite-momentum pairing. In the BEC regime, this universal quadratic correction corresponds to the altered effective mass of the tightly bound composite bosons. The model therefore provides a simple setting in which to compare altermagnetic pair breaking on the BCS and BEC sides of the crossover.

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Intrinsic Wannier Functions for Hamiltonian downfolding
full_list.title_zh: 哈密顿向下折叠的内在 Wannier 函数
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.15557v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Downfolding ab initio material band structure into a low-energy subspace spanned by orbitals of specified atomic character, a procedure known as Wannier downfolding, is a common task in the simulation of complex materials. We introduce the Intrinsic Wannier Function (IWF) method to Wannierize bands with given atomic character. The method is non-iterative and requires only a single dimensionless parameter to disentangle bands. In benchmarks on silicon, graphene, and the three-band model of a mercury cuprate, we show that Intrinsic Wannier Functions provide high quality downfolded band structures compared to those from standard approaches such as Maximally Localized Wannier Functions, the Selected Columns of the Density Matrix method, and Projectability-Disentangled Wannier Functions. Further, their straightforward implementation and robustness position Intrinsic Wannier Functions as a general and useful tool for Wannier downfolding in materials electronic structure and in high-throughput applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 将从头开始的材料能带结构向下折叠到由指定原子特征的轨道跨越的低能子空间中，这一过程称为万尼尔向下折叠，是复杂材料模拟中的一项常见任务。我们引入了本征万尼尔函数 (IWF) 方法来对具有给定原子特征的能带进行万尼尔化。该方法是非迭代的，仅需要一个无量纲参数来解开带。在硅、石墨烯和汞铜酸盐的三能带模型的基准测试中，我们表明，与最大局部化万尼尔函数、密度矩阵方法的选定列和可投影性解缠结万尼尔函数等标准方法相比，本征万尼尔函数提供了高质量的下折叠能带结构。

full_list.title_en: Thermally Hysteretic Room-Temperature Nonlinear Hall Effect in Bulk EuTe4
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Thermally Hysteretic Room-Temperature Nonlinear Hall Effect in Bulk EuTe4
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) is a novel transport phenomena and shows great potential applications of future electronics. However, the realization of a giant and tunable NLHE in bulk materials at room temperature remains elusive. Here, we report a NLHE in bulk EuTe4 single crystals, which persists up to 400 K and exhibits pronounced thermal hysteresis behaviors. The ratio of nonlinear Hall voltages during warming and cooling processes is about 4.7 at 340 K. Such phenomena could be related to the inversion-symmetry-broken charge density wave state in EuTe4. These findings demonstrate bulk EuTe₄ as a promising platform for tunable nonlinear electronic devices at room temperature.

full_list.title_en: Blind in-memory arithmetic with confined skyrmions: doubling and successor functions on a skyrmion byte
full_list.title_zh: 具有受限斯格明子的盲内存算术：斯格明子字节上的加倍和后继函数
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a skyrmionic-based computation platform, able to perform fully in-memory computing by collectively manipulating the skyrmions that serve as bits of the binary memory. The computation protocols are implemented through driving currents and adequately located anisotropy defects that modify the dynamics of the skyrmions along a magnetic track. Simulations demonstrating the feasibility of such an in-memory computing system are shown for several basic and simple mathematical operations with natural numbers, such as doubling and adding one (the successor function). We also discuss how further optimization of the geometry, barrier profiles, current amplitudes, and timing parameters could improve both the robustness and the overall practical feasibility of the system.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于斯格明子的计算平台，该平台能够通过集体操纵用作二进制存储器比特的斯格明子来执行完全的内存内计算。计算协议通过驱动电流和位于适当位置的各向异性缺陷来实现，这些缺陷会改变斯格明子沿磁道运动的动力学行为。针对几种使用自然数的简单基本数学运算（例如加倍和加一（后继函数）），我们展示了证明此类内存中计算系统可行性的模拟。我们还讨论了如何通过进一步优化几何形状、势垒轮廓、电流幅度和时序参数来提高系统的鲁棒性和整体实用可行性。

full_list.title_en: Spin-adapted sample-based quantum diagonalization with randomized time evolution
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Spin-adapted sample-based quantum diagonalization with randomized time evolution
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum algorithms based on the classical post-processing of measurement samples have emerged as effective and robust methods to approximate low-energy wavefunctions of many-body quantum systems on present-day and early-fault-tolerant quantum devices. This paper introduces a generic framework for enforcing spin symmetry within these approaches. We tailor this framework to SqDRIFT, a sample-based quantum diagonalization variant that uses the qDRIFT randomized compilation protocol to generate the quantum samples. We discuss how three key components of SqDRIFT (the initial-state preparation, the construction of the time-evolution circuits, and the classical post-processing) can be adapted to incorporate spin symmetry. We show that spin-pure circuits alone are not sufficient, since the sampled determinants generally span a subspace that is not closed under hatS², and we restore this closure by completing the sampled electronic configurations. In classical simulations of 4-aminobenzonitrile and of an [Fe(NH₃)₄]²⁺ model complex, and in experiments on an IBM quantum processor for the oxo-Mn(Salen) complex, this spin-adapted post-processing yields roots that are exact spin eigenfunctions at every subspace size. On hardware, it does so with diagonalized subspaces two to three orders of magnitude smaller than those of the conventional constructions for the same circuit depth.

full_list.title_en: Macroscopic Nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer Mediated by Coherent Magnons
full_list.title_zh: 相干磁振子介导的宏观核共振能量转移
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31507v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Phonon-mediated nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer (RET) in metal deuterides is severely constrained by inertial rest-mass dilution, lattice fracture limits, and thermal nuclear spin cancellation. Extending the generalized nuclear Dicke model to Ferromagnetic Resonance (FMR) magnons eliminates mass dilution via hyperfine-amplified M1 coupling while unlocking relativistic Dirac M2 coupling via Overhauser spin polarization. We derive a Suhl-clamped FMR scaling law predicting 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) and 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) breakup neutrons, 19.9 MeV alpha particles, and reconciled sub-keV fusion anomalies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 金属氘化物中声子介导的核共振能量转移（RET）受到惯性静止质量稀释、晶格断裂极限和热核自旋抵消的严重限制。将广义核迪克模型扩展到铁磁共振 (FMR) 磁振子，可以通过超精细放大 M1 耦合消除质量稀释，同时通过 Overhauser 自旋极化解锁相对论狄拉克 M2 耦合。我们推导出 Suhl 钳位 FMR 标度定律，预测 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) 和 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) 破裂中子、19.9 MeV α 粒子和协调的亚 keV 聚变异常。

full_list.title_en: Aggregation and impurity effects on the photophysics of ultralong organic phosphorescence in carbazole derivatives
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Aggregation and impurity effects on the photophysics of ultralong organic phosphorescence in carbazole derivatives
full_list.abstract: Ultralong organic phosphorescence in carbazole derivatives involves interconnected photophysical processes. Although experimental studies have proposed various possible mechanisms, the connections among excited state electronic structure, impurity induced changes in excited states, excitation energy migration, and emission processes still need to be elucidated from a state-resolved perspective. Here, we study the corresponding photophysical processes in pristine DPhCzT- and DPhBdT-doped crystals using electronic structure calculations, fragment particle–hole density diabatization, vibronic spectral simulations, and rate calculations. In pristine aggregates, weak intermolecular excitonic coupling is insufficient to significantly stabilize triplet energy. The fluorescence and phosphorescence arise mainly from localized excited states. After introducing DPhBdT impurities, the energy level distribution and character of the low energy excited states change markedly. A low energy charge transfer (CT) state and an impurity localized triplet state form at the host–guest interface, corresponding to fluorescence and phosphorescence emission, respectively. In finite aggregates, charge separated states lie at substantially higher energies and are not identified as the dominant low energy photophysical pathway. Significantly, the CT state suppresses the decay channel competing with intersystem crossing (ISC) and increases the total ISC rate, thereby promoting triplet state population.

full_list.title_zh: Floquet 腔磁振子学中的不对称模式杂交
full_list.abstract: Author(s): Amin Pishehvar, Jayakrishnan M. P. Nair, Zixin Yan, Yu Jiang, Benedetta Flebus, and Xufeng Zhang Controllable mode hybridization is a versatile means to engineer interactions between distinct degrees of freedom of spin waves, but previous demonstrations have been limited to symmetric cases. This study use phase-coherent, dual-tone Floquet driving to break the symmetry of magnon-photon hybridization, creating interference between multiple pathways with relative strengths controlled by the drive phase. This interference produces unequal Autler-Townes splittings for the two interacting modes, enabling continuously tunable asymmetric hybridization, and thus providing a programmable approach to engineering such interactions in driven and hybrid systems. full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《双层 CrS2 中插层诱导的强多铁性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic anisotropy, first-order metamagnetic transitions, and weak antilocalization in the candidate topological semimetal Tb₂Zn₁₇
full_list.title_zh: 候选拓扑半金属 Tb2Zn₁₇ 的磁各向异性、一阶变磁转变和弱反局域化
full_list.abstract: Author(s): Rajesh Swami, Papul Sahu, Sonali S Pradhan, V. Kanchana, and Z. Hossain Tb 2 Zn 17 crystallizes in the rhombohedral Th 2 Zn 17 -type structure (space group R 3 ¯ m ), a structure type known to accommodate atomic disorder. Here, the authors highlight the role of disorder-induced scattering in magnetotransport measurements, which exhibit signatures of weak antilocalization. This compound shows multiple first-order field-induced metamagnetic transitions, strong magnetic anisotropy, crystal electric field effects, and possible spin canting within its antiferromagnetic state. First-principles calculations predict multiple electron and hole Fermi pockets, along with mirror-symmetry-protected nodal rings, suggesting Tb 2 Zn 17 as a promising rare-earth-based magnetic topological semimetal. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 305113] Published Mon Nov 16, 2026
full_list.abstract_zh: 作者：Rajesh Swami、Papul Sahu、Sonali S Pradhan、V. Kanchana 和 Z. Hossain Tb 2 Zn 17 以菱面体 Th 2 Zn 17 型结构（空间群 R 3 ¯ m ）结晶，这是一种已知可适应原子无序的结构类型。在这里，作者强调了无序引起的散射在磁输运测量中的作用，它表现出弱反局域化的特征。该化合物表现出多个一阶场诱发的变磁转变、强磁各向异性、晶体电场效应以及其反铁磁态内可能的自旋倾斜。

full_list.title_en: Anyon Proliferation at Self-Triality: From a Lattice Model to Adjoint QCD₃
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anyon Proliferation at Self-Triality: From a Lattice Model to Adjoint QCD₃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17724v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how competitive proliferation among three types of anyons in a self-trial Z₂timesZ₂ gauge theory can drive symmetry breaking while preserving part of the topological order. We construct a deformation of the honeycomb color code, a spin model rooted in quantum error correction, with an S₃ symmetry that permutes the competing anyons, together with time-reversal and fermionic Z₂⁽¹⁾ one-form symmetries. We propose two dual continuum descriptions of this transition. The bosonic description is a PSU(3)₃timesSpin(8)₋₁ Chern-Simons-Higgs theory with a real Higgs field in the (8ₐdⱼ,8ᵥ) representation. Fermion-boson duality gives a particularly simple fermionic dual: PSU(3)₃/₂ QCD₃ with a single adjoint Majorana fermion and gauged fermion parity. Both descriptions match the lattice model's unitary symmetries and proposed phase diagram, connecting double-toric-code order to a symmetry-broken phase with residual toric-code order. The transition is described by Higgs condensation and by a Majorana mass changing sign, respectively. The continuum theories are proposed to recover lattice time reversal at criticality. This connection to adjoint QCD₃ points to a possible continuous S₃-breaking transition from competing anyons, in contrast to the conventional first-order three-state Potts transition from competing local order parameters.

full_list.title_en: Charge and spin orders of the generalized Wigner crystal phases at fractional fillings in twisted MoTe₂: unrestricted Hartree-Fock and variational Monte Carlo studies
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Charge and spin orders of the generalized Wigner crystal phases at fractional fillings in twisted MoTe₂: unrestricted Hartree-Fock and variational Monte Carlo studies
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.18029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments have revealed interaction-driven insulating states at various fractional fillings of twisted bilayer MoTe₂. Many of these insulating states are believed to be generalized Wigner crystals (GWC) condensed in the background of triangular moiracutee lattice. In this work, we focus on revealing the charge and spin order of the insulating states at 4/3 and 3/2 hole fillings over a range of twist angles and applied displacement fields using unrestricted Hartree-Fock (HF) and variational Monte Carlo (VMC) methods. We find that, at 4/3 filling for low twist angles the charge ordered ground state is valley-polarized (VP), characterized by weak charge delocalization approaching the classical limit. Application of the displacement field induces layer-polarization and suppresses the charge fluctuations even further. In contrast, at 3/2 filling, the VP phase exhibits signatures of a two-component GWC phase, which is particularly robust at finite displacement field. Additionally, by increasing the twist angle one pushes the system into an intervalley-coherent (IVC) phase, which is found to be fluctuation-dominated. Our VMC-based analysis shows that the correlation energy is negligible in the VP phase, which is consistent with its classical nature. However, the IVC phase shows significant gain in correlation energy, which is dominated by the nonlocal correlations captured by the Jastrow factors, while the local Gutzwiller factors play a minor role.

full_list.title_en: Complex Schrödinger Bridges
full_list.title_zh: 复杂的薛定谔桥
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion bridges have emerged as versatile frameworks for facilitating transformations between arbitrary data distributions. However, these approaches are hindered by an immense optimization space and its underlying high-order structures. This paper explores a variant of diffusion bridges for solving real-world problems in complex vector spaces governed by scaling and rotation laws, such as Hamiltonian structures. To address this, we introduce conformal optimal transport (COT), a complex-valued transportation framework designed for physical systems with geometric and dissipative dynamics under a geometric lifting. Building on this, we propose a new class of dynamical diffusion bridges, called complex Schrödinger bridges (CSBs), whose derived algorithms can handle diffusion-based tasks using a conformal geometric prior. For scalability, we propose image-to-image CSB (I²CSB), a tractable diffusion-bridge technique with an analytic spiral posterior. Finally, we implement a physics-informed CSB algorithm within simulations of quantum electrodynamics, mimicking the logical behavior of quantum logic gates. Our extensive results validate the underlying theory while highlighting advantages of complex-valued diffusion.
full_list.abstract_zh: 扩散桥已成为促进任意数据分布之间转换的通用框架。然而，这些方法受到巨大的优化空间及其底层高阶结构的阻碍。本文探讨了扩散桥的一种变体，用于解决受缩放和旋转定律（例如哈密顿结构）控制的复杂向量空间中的现实问题。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了共形最优传输（COT），这是一种复值传输框架，专为几何提升下具有几何和耗散动力学的物理系统而设计。在此基础上，我们提出了一类新的动态扩散桥，称为复杂薛定谔桥（CSB），其派生算法可以使用共形几何先验来处理基于扩散的任务。

full_list.title_en: Dopant-vacancy complexes as single-photon-emitter candidates in monolayer silicon carbide: radiative and nonradiative decay
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dopant-vacancy complexes as single-photon-emitter candidates in monolayer silicon carbide: radiative and nonradiative decay
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid-state color centers have emerged as promising single-photon sources (SPSs). In particular, color centers in two-dimensional (2D) materials combine high photon brightness with scalable fabrication and ease of integration, offering a versatile platform for quantum information technologies. Realizing high-efficiency SPSs, however, requires strong radiative emission and negligible nonradiative decay. Using first-principles calculations, we assess radiative and nonradiative decay in dopant-vacancy complexes XSiVC (X = N, O, P, and S) in monolayer silicon carbide. All four defects exhibit stable neutral charge states and inter-defect optical transitions. Among them, PSiVC emerges as the leading single-photon-emitter candidate, combining rapid radiative decay with negligible nonradiative decay and a near-unity quantum yield within the modeled channels. By contrast, multiphonon decay limits the quantum yield of NSiVC despite its high Debye-Waller factor. Hyperfine tensors provide characteristic signatures for identifying the spin-active centers. Beyond identifying promising candidates, these results establish a joint radiative-nonradiative screening strategy and provide theoretical guidance for the rational design of color centers as solid-state SPSs.
